_doc: One portrait page per chain boss (boss = its step in BossProgression.CHAIN, 1-10). 'met:N' = boss N's pages are revealed (boss N-1 is dead); 'slain:N' = boss N is dead. /pptest chronicle reveals everything.

elements.quote: Ten great beasts hold the seas. They must be hunted in order.

elements.p: Click a name to turn to its pages.
A walled fort on the jungle islands, full of crew, cannons and powder. Rackham fights with a flintlock and a cutlass. His parrot Polly fights too.
Pistol shots and a three-slash Cutlass Flurry. He rolls Powder Kegs at you; shoot one to set it off early. He whistles up crew, four at most.

At half health he goes POWDER-MAD: he throws bundles of dynamite and calls a BROADSIDE. Red rings on the ground show where the fort's cannons will hit. Once he drops below a quarter, he stops for a swig of grog.
The fort cannons keep firing while he lives, so keep moving. Rubble blocks his vault, and only thrown dynamite clears it. The fort's magazine has plenty.

elements.row: Relic: Diving Charm - breathe under water

elements.quote: The Hold is quiet now. The charm smells of brine and gunpowder, and it pulls toward the deep water.

elements.torn: These pages are torn out. They will ink themselves back in once Captain Rackham is dead.

elements.p: A flooded dome under the seabed. A giant stone serpent head marks the way in; swim in through its mouth and down its throat.
Bite, Tail Lash, Constrict and a Pressure Jet that blasts you back. It hides in the silt too: watch for a column of bubbles where it's about to burst out.
At half health it becomes STORMSCALE: whirlpools, a crackling Storm Surge (get out of the ring), and a brood of void squid.

Four Tideward Stones in the lair armour it; each one still standing cuts your damage. Only a TIDEBREAKER can break them. One lies in the Tidewater Shrine's vault, behind a door you'll need dynamite for.

elements.row: Relic: Tide Pearl - no scalding water

elements.quote: The stones are quiet. The pearl is warm, and the seas beyond steam.

elements.name: The Molten Warlord
elements.hint: Revealed when the Sea Serpent falls.

elements.torn: Scorched away. The words come back once the Sea Serpent is dead.
Scorched away. There is more hunting to do before these words come back.

elements.p: A fortress of basalt with four doors you have to blast open. A half-slab stair spirals down to the Crucible, where he waits.

Mace Lash: a line of dust shows where the flail will strike. Flail Whirl: stand right next to him or well back, never in between. Fissure Slam sends cracks racing across the floor. Chain Hook drags you in.
At half health his core ignites: meteors rain down, fire sprites join the fight, and his core vents.
His armour halves your damage. Pull a QUENCH VALVE and water pours down for a few seconds. Lure him under it and he cools: stunned, softer, and much easier to hurt.

elements.row: Relic: Everburning Lantern - no blindness or darkness

elements.quote: The forge is cold. The lantern still burns, and it burns brightest near ghosts.

elements.name: The Ghost Captain
elements.hint: Revealed when the Molten Warlord falls.

elements.torn: Water-stained past reading. It will clear once the Molten Warlord is dead.
Water-stained past reading. Something else must die first.

elements.p: On a small islet among sunken masts, a bell hangs over a phantom buoy. Ring it and the FLYING DUTCHMAN rises. Bring your own ship.
While his ship floats, the captain is bound to its deck and can't be hurt. He fires Soul Beams, and his ghost cannons fire broadsides at you.
Sink the Dutchman with cannon fire. Once it goes down he breaks free and BOARDS YOUR SHIP. Then it's a duel on your own deck.

elements.row: Relic: Spectral Anchor - a clear mind in the Abyss

elements.quote: The bell no longer rings. Out past the last ring, something is waiting in the deep.

elements.name: The Abyssal King
elements.hint: Revealed when the Ghost Captain falls.

elements.torn: These pages are soaked black. They'll dry out once the Ghost Captain is dead.
These pages are soaked black. Another beast stands before this one.

elements.p: A sunken palace. In its forecourt, the Well of Tides drops down to the Court Door. Behind that door is a flooded hall and the King's throne.
The sea protects him: he takes only a third of your damage. Four TIDE SLUICES each drain a quarter of the hall. Open all four and he is STRANDED, kneeling and weak.
He tries to reseal them. Hit him hard or throw a DEPTH CHARGE to stop him. Tide Wardens will also walk over and wind the sluices shut.

Riptide Charge (a boiling lane shows its path), Trident Volley, Crushing Depths (swim out of the shrinking bubble ring) and Royal Guard. When enraged: Maelstrom, and Undertow rings you have to swim over or under.

elements.row: Relic: Royal Tide Sigil - no pulls, no slowness

elements.quote: The throne is empty. Back home in the Starter Seas, there's blood in the water.

elements.name: The Bloodfin
elements.hint: Revealed when the Abyssal King falls.

elements.torn: Something tore these pages with its teeth. They'll return once the Abyssal King is dead.
Something tore these pages with its teeth. You are not ready for them.

elements.p: A ring-shaped reef around a deep lagoon. Four old whaling platforms stand in it, each with a HARPOON WINCH.
A single harpoon PINS it for a few seconds, and while pinned it takes double damage. Afterwards it is wary and dodges harpoons for a while. Crank the winch to pull it in; reload with harpoons.
As it gets hurt, it sheds chunks of flesh that float. It stops to eat them, and it will also stop for CHUM you throw. While it eats it holds still, so harpoon it.

It can grab you in its jaws, dive, and leap. Deal enough damage while it has you and it gags and lets go. At half health it goes into a BLOOD FRENZY: bites that bleed, darkness, and a hunt from below. A fin cutting the surface means it's under you.

elements.row: Relic: Razor Tooth - nothing can hold you

elements.quote: The lagoon has gone still. Out in the Coral Bay, the reef looks like it's breathing.

elements.torn: Covered in ink. It will run clear once the Bloodfin is dead.
Covered in ink. Other beasts must fall first.

elements.p: A bowl sunk into the seabed with a deep shaft in the middle. The Kraken lurks at the bottom and can't be hurt. Six ARMS burst out of burrows around the bowl; cut down all six and it RISES.
Its arms slam, sweep and grab. More arms grow back at two thirds and at one third of its health, and while any are alive the head takes half damage.
SWALLOW: it breathes in and sucks you toward its mouth. Once you're inside, your blows hurt it three times as much. Then it spits you out, and swats you.
It also spits harpoons that pin you to the rock. When it raises the TENTACLE BULWARK, get back: the BURST comes right after. It shakes the seabed with Quakes, and when enraged it calls a Maelstrom.

elements.quote: The ink has cleared. Far away in the Cursed Seas, chains are rattling.

elements.torn: This page has been cut down like a hanged man. It returns once the Kraken is dead.
This page has been cut down like a hanged man. You are not ready for it.

elements.p: Hangman's Rock is a crag with a dead harbour around it. A well-house opens onto the Grand Stair, which winds down past the Gibbet Gallery and the Gaol, then through a gate carved like a skull. At the bottom is the Gallows Pit.
He hangs from the gallows by his wrists. A sword is stuck in the stone beneath him. Pull it out and the chains break. That sword, the GALLOWBRAND, can be thrown, and it comes back to you.

He was drawn and quartered; only the chains hold him together. At certain points his limbs fly off to anchors on the walls. Strike the limbs until they fall. His head can't be hurt, but a TIDESHACKLE (from the Coral Temple) will cage it. Once every limb is down he pulls himself back together, stunned and vulnerable.

Watch out for THE QUARTERING (red spokes on the floor) and THE HANGMAN'S FLOOR (a checkerboard of trapdoors). The lights on the pit walls go out one by one. When the last one dies, so does his patience.

elements.row: Relic: Broken Shackle - wounds that won't heal

elements.quote: The chains hang empty. Down in the Maw Depths, something is beating.

elements.name: The Abyssal Heart
elements.hint: Revealed when the Chained Revenant falls.

elements.torn: The page trembles at a steady beat, but the ink won't take. Kill the Chained Revenant first.
The page trembles at a steady beat, but the ink won't take. Not yet.

elements.p: This is the Tide Father's heart, sealed inside a dead titan's ribs. Every attack is announced on one beat and lands on the next. Count the beats.
At first it barely feels your blows. Strike the four GALVANIC PYLONS while they glow green, in time with the beat. Get all four and its heart STOPS: for a few seconds it takes double damage.
An EMBOLISM rides the blood ring around it. Kill one and the Heart is wounded directly.

At half health it CLOTS and swallows you into its chambers. The valves slam shut on every beat. Burst the four nodes, but only in the beat window. At a quarter it FLATLINES, and the Eye of Thalassar shocks it back to life with memories of every beast you've killed.

elements.quote: The heart is stone. There is nothing left for the Leviathan to fear.

elements.name: The Leviathan
elements.lair: The Rift, the Gullet, the Spire
elements.hint: Revealed when the Abyssal Heart falls.

elements.torn: Nothing is written here. Nobody who saw it came back to write it.

elements.p: There is ONE Leviathan in the world, and once killed it never returns. You fight it in three lairs, and its health carries over between them. Each time it loses a third, it flees along its route, and it wrecks a port on the way. You can follow it.
A stone crust shields it; explosions break it. Four chains bind it to ANCHOR WINCHES; wind them tight. It Yawns, Coil Crushes, and lashes you with the chains it snaps.
An eclipse falls. It hunts the biggest meal in reach. Feed it a POWDER BARGE: the poisoned meal stuns it, and its head takes heavy damage. If it goes hungry for too long, it weakens.

The channel is sealed and THE LAST TIDE rises. Silence the four TIDE BELLS to slow it. Knock the BANE SHAFT from the Spire's crown. Load the BANE BALLISTA with the Heartstone, the shaft and 16 gunpowder, then fire while the Leviathan rears. If the tide reaches the crown, it escapes. Blow the Watcher's Horn to call it back.

elements.quote: The sea is quiet for the first time in an age. Wear the crown well, Captain. Every sea is yours.
